question: Does the integral H-equivariant endomorphism assembled in 05AD determine an integral divisor class on S0=(X(8)xX(8))/H_diag with the exact D0 degree/intersection package, or is there a residual integral descent/saturation obstruction invisible over Q?

parent_05ad.exact_use: For each residue 73,97,235 there is an integral H-equivariant F in End(JX8) with invariant-part trace 1204, nontrivial character traces 18,274,18 and deck-cross traces 1514,1442,930,930.

beauville_x8_quotient.author: Arnaud Beauville
beauville_x8_quotient.title: Some surfaces with maximal Picard number
beauville_x8_quotient.exact_use: For C=X(8), H=Gamma~=(Z/2)^2 acts freely and S0=(C x C)/H_diag satisfies NS(S0) tensor Q = Q^2 direct-sum (End_H(JC) tensor Q). Thus every H-equivariant rational endomorphism component determines a rational Neron-Severi class downstairs; the proposition does not identify the integral lattice or prove integral saturation.

fpqc_descent_external.exact_use: A genuine descent datum for an invertible sheaf over the finite etale H-torsor is effective. Therefore the unresolved issue is existence of the integral descent datum / membership in the integral pullback lattice, not effectiveness after such datum is supplied.

upstairs_05h.exact_use: The retained hypothetical D0 package on S0 has D0^2=3874, K_S0.D0=372, p_a(D0)=2124 and residual-deck intersections 3874,3892,4020,4020.

cover_and_lattices.rational_identification: p^* NS(S0)_Q = NS(X)^H_Q on the correspondence summand by Beauville Proposition 8(b)
cover_and_lattices.transfer_identity: For alpha in NS(X)^H, p^* p_* alpha = sum_{h in H} h^*alpha = 4 alpha.
cover_and_lattices.consequence: Any invariant integral alpha becomes descended after multiplication by 4; exact descent of alpha itself is a finite 2-primary saturation question.

assembled_upstairs_correspondence_class.reason_H_invariant: The two fiber degrees are H-invariant and the correspondence summand F commutes with H.

downstairs_numeric_candidate.beta_F: the unique rational NS(S0) class whose pullback is alpha_F on the fixed bidegree/correspondence coordinates

integral_descent_boundary.unknown_finite_group: cokernel/saturation of p^*:NS(S0)->NS(X)^H at the three alpha_F classes; exponent divides 4 by transfer, but exact order 1/2/4 is not retained
missing_exact_inputs: an integral NS(S0) basis with intersection form and explicit p^* matrix
or an equivalent H-linearized Picard descent adapter for the correspondence class
or an explicit divisor-class construction on S0 whose pullback has the 05AD correspondence coordinates
integral_descent_boundary.why_beauville_is_not_enough: Beauville computes NS(S0) only after tensoring with Q for this purpose. Rank equality/rho-maximality does not prove that a specified invariant integral class is primitive in the pullback image.

decision.exact_blocker: All rational and numerical data match the retained hypothetical D0 exactly, but the repository lacks the integral quotient Picard/Neron-Severi lattice or an explicit H-linearization proving that alpha_F itself, rather than only 4*alpha_F, is a pullback from S0.
decision.reopen_condition: Resolve with a bounded integral lattice computation for S0 or an explicit equivariant line-bundle/divisor construction. No full Q602 shell or heavy workflow is needed.

next_route.selection_reason: 05AE shows that the rational class and every retained numerical invariant already match D0. The nearest stronger EX1-owned question is the finite integral index of the diagonal-V4 pullback lattice at the three assembled classes.
